question: The distance covered by a train in (5y - 1) hours is (125y³ - 1) km. The speed of the train is :
solution:
Given:

The distance covered by a train in (5y - 1) hours is (125y3 - 1) km. 

Concept used:

a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

Calculation:

Speed of the train

⇒ (125y3 - 1) ÷ (5y - 1)

⇒ frac {(5y)³ - 1}{(5y - 1)}

⇒ frac {(5y - 1)(25y² + 5y + 1)}{(5y - 1)}

⇒ (25y2 + 5y + 1) km/h

**∴ The speed of the train is (25y2 + 5y + 1) km/h.**
